question: Which version of this OmniScript or Integration Procedure is active, and who touched each version?

steps.name: versions
steps.soql: SELECT Name, VersionNumber, IsActive, IsIntegrationProcedure, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM OmniProcess WHERE Type = '{type}' AND SubType = '{subtype}' ORDER BY VersionNumber DESC

verdicts.say: {type}/{subtype} has {versions.rows} version(s) and none is active.
{type}/{subtype}: version {= versions.records.find(r => r.IsActive).VersionNumber} is active, {versions.rows} version(s) in total.

traps: Two orgs on the same version number means a deploy overwrites in place. A higher target version survives as inactive.
A recent LastModifiedBy who is not you means someone may be mid-change. Ask before editing.
